facts.text: SMC100 is Newport's single-axis motion controller
The serial link is 57600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, XON/XOFF flow control with a 50 ms read timeout
A command is the controller ID, the command word and the argument, then CR LF
A query passes '?' as the argument; sendcmd refuses a command that ends with '?'
TS? returns a four-hex-digit error code followed by the two-character controller state
TP? returns the position in millimetres
PR moves by a relative distance in millimetres and PA to an absolute position in millimetres
OR starts homing; after homing the upstream moves the stage to 0 mm
The stage units are stage-dependent; the author's TRB25CC stage uses millimetres
The controller reports the DISABLE states 3C, 3D and 3E
wait_states gives up after MAX_WAIT_TIME_SEC = 12 s
A command that expects no reply is followed by at least COMMAND_WAIT_TIME_SEC = 0.06 s
PR and OR are never retried automatically
